title: Towards Responsible AI in Education: Hybrid Recommendation System for K-12 Students Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the difference in recommendation precision between male and female K-12 students using explicit positive and negative user feedback.
Calculating the difference in recommendation precision across different student race codes based on explicit user feedback.
Evaluating differences in recommendation precision based on parental presence (e.g., mother only, father only, both parents) and foster care status.
Measuring variations in recommendation precision between students identified as homeless and those who are not.
Comparing recommendation precision between students identified as immigrants or migrants versus those who are not.
Evaluating differences in recommendation precision between students enrolled in Gifted/Talented programs and those who are not.
